Cash and cash equivalents, short-term debt, long-term debt and total debt are point-in-time balances; no point-in-time (December 30, 2023 / December 31, 2022) balance sheet table was supplied. A precise gap is returned rather than a derived figure.

Shares outstanding is not presented in the supplied blocks. The only share quantities shown are weighted-average 'Shares used in per share calculation' (Basic 1,614 / 1,561 / 1,213; Diluted 1,625 / 1,571 / 1,229), which are not the same as shares outstanding and were not mapped to the shares_outstanding metric.
Basic and diluted earnings per share (0.53 / 0.85 / 2.61 and 0.53 / 0.84 / 2.57) are presented but are outside the requested core metric catalog and were not retained as mapped candidates.

The statement line is captioned only 'Net income'; whether it equals total net income including noncontrolling interests or is parent-attributable is not distinguished in the supplied blocks, and no noncontrolling interest line was delivered.

Balance-sheet parenthetical share-capital disclosures (e.g., par value, authorized/issued shares) and any restatement, restriction or definition notes accompanying the delivered table are in undelivered blocks and remain pending.

Comparative columns are presented for the years ended December 31, 2022 and December 25, 2021 per the source headers; fiscal-period catalog start dates for FY2022 and FY2021 are taken from the supplied catalog, not from the delivered table.
